title: Extra Enchants
description: This mod adds more enchants to the game.
body:
This mod adds more enchants to the game, such as:
- Passthrough: Allows entities to deal a small amount of damage through shields
- Catalyst: Acts like a Sculk Catalyst when you kill a mob
- Pullback: Pulls entities back when attacked

More may be added in the future.
This mod was made using MCreator 2025.3 with the Fabric Generator plugin installed.
